subject: pathology
title: Bone tumours and metabolic bone disease

steps.tx: **Osteosarcoma** (adolescents, distal femur or proximal tibia **metaphysis**, lifting periosteum into **Codman triangle** with **sunburst spiculation**, pulmonary mets) is biopsied then treated by **MAP chemotherapy** (methotrexate, Adriamycin, cisplatin) with **limb salvage** surgery; necrosis percent grades response. Paget secondary osteosarcoma (elderly) and post radiation variants behave worse; skip metastases MRI stage. Painful enlarging metaphyseal mass with raised ALP alarms.
steps.say: Teen knee metaphyseal sunburst with Codman is osteosarcoma: MAP then salvage. Paget bone sarcoma behaves worse.

vis.alt: Diagram of osteosarcoma in distal femur showing Codman triangle, sunburst spiculation, and lung metastases.
vis.caption: Osteosarcoma: classic radiographic features and pulmonary metastases

steps.tx: **Ewing sarcoma** (children, **diaphyseal** femur or pelvis, **onion skin** periosteal layering, small round blue cells with **EWS-FLI1** translocation, fever mimicking osteomyelitis) is treated by multiagent chemotherapy with surgery or radiotherapy (pelvis often rays); lung and marrow stage. **Chondrosarcoma** (older adults, pelvis and shoulder, **rings and arcs** calcification, IDH mutations, chemo resistant) needs wide resection; dedifferentiated variants kill fast. Small round blue differentials (lymphoma, rhabdomyosarcoma, neuroblastoma) immunophenotype.
steps.say: Diaphyseal onion skin febrile child is Ewing: EWS-FLI1, chemo plus rays. Pelvic rings and arcs older is chondrosarcoma: resect wide.

vis.alt: Side-by-side comparison of Ewing sarcoma in the femoral diaphysis with onion-skin periosteal reaction and small round blue cells versus pelvic chondrosarcoma with rings-and-arcs calcification.
vis.caption: Ewing sarcoma (onion-skin periosteum) vs chondrosarcoma (rings-and-arcs calcification).

steps.tx: **Benign tumours** behave by age and site: **giant cell tumour** (skeletally mature **epiphysis**, soap bubble lytic, RANKL driven, **denosumab** with curettage), **osteochondroma** (metaphyseal exostosis pointing away, cartilage cap, EXT genes, secondary chondrosarcoma when cap thickens), enchondroma (Ollier multiples, Maffucci with haemangiomas), **aneurysmal bone cyst** (blowout with fluid levels, USP6) versus unicameral (fallen fragment sign, steroids or curettage), nonossifying fibroma (cortical, regresses). Epiphyseal lytic adult is GCT until proven.
steps.say: Epiphyseal soap bubble adult is giant cell: denosumab, curette. Exostosis cap thickening turns malignant.

steps.tx: **Paget disease** (elderly, **mosaic cement lines**, hat size growing with deafness, high ALP, osteosarcoma risk) is treated by **bisphosphonates** for pain or complications; **fibrous dysplasia** (**GNAS**, ground glass with **shepherd crook** deformity, McCune-Albright with cafe au lait and precocity, Mazabraud with myxomas) observes or fixes deformity. **Osteoporosis** (postmenopausal, DEXA T under minus 2.5, fragility hip and spine, bisphosphonates with calcium and vitamin D) differs by density; osteomalacia (Looser zones, low phosphate) mineralises poorly.
steps.say: Growing hat deaf high ALP is Paget: bisphosphonate. Ground glass shepherd crook is fibrous dysplasia.
